principles: Pastel base (tints at 85-92% lightness) for backgrounds and panels
3px outline on all gameplay pieces and buttons in a 25% darker shade of the fill (HSL L -25), never pure black
Rounded sans display (Fredoka / M PLUS Rounded 1c / Zen Maru Gothic for JP) 700 for titles
palette_strategy: Pastel base (tints at 85-92% lightness) for backgrounds and panels; exactly 3 saturated accents reserved for CTA, reward and selection states; never more than 2 saturated hues on one screen outside reward moments

illustration.asset_rendering: vector flat with one soft shade band in a hue-shifted (toward purple) darker tone

components.button.primary: Pill primary 56px tall, fill = primary, 3px darker-shade outline, 4px hard bottom shadow, label 18px 700 centred with 1px darker text shadow; secondary = surface fill with primary outline; pressed = translate 3px down and drop shadow in 90ms
components.popup: Rounded panel radius 28px, surface fill, 4px outline in secondary-darker, ribbon title plate overlapping the top edge by 50%; close button circular 44px top-right; entrance scale 0.85 to 1 with overshoot 1.04 in 260ms
components.hud: Top bar 64px with coin/life/timer capsules (pill, surface fill, 2px outline); timer bar uses accent fill with rounded ends; never more than 3 capsules; gameplay grid gets at least 85% of vertical space in portrait
components.reward: Reward popups go one saturation step higher (accent plus gold); confetti of 3 shapes max (circle, star, heart) in palette colours; mascot cheer pose; sparkle burst 6-8 rays; bounce to 1.1 scale synced to sound

anti_patterns: Thin stroke icons mixed with filled
Sharp-corner tiles next to pill buttons
More than 3 saturated hues on the gameplay screen
Timer bar that turns red and pulses for the whole level
Tile faces with busy background patterns
Mixed animal art styles across species
qa_criteria: All outlines are darker shades of their own fill, never #000
Corner radius within the xl class on every panel and button
Text contrast at least 4.5:1 on the cream background
Tile silhouettes identical size and radius across the grid
Reward screen uses the same character style as home
unknowns: success: built-in status fill darkened from #138B3F to #107435 for contrast (5.88:1 on {primitive.color.white})
button.secondary.fg: primary-family label stepped from #FF8FAB to brand.700 (#BA4A66) to reach 4.5:1 on the secondary states

catalog_rules.shape_language: Rounded-blob silhouettes; tiles are superellipses (squircles) not circles; no acute angles anywhere in UI; character heads 1.3-1.5x body width; panel corners visibly rounder than tile corners
catalog_rules.outline_rule: 3px outline on all gameplay pieces and buttons in a 25% darker shade of the fill (HSL L -25), never pure black; HUD text panels 2px outline in surface-darker; outline width scales with element size (min 2px at 32px, 4px at 128px+)
catalog_rules.highlight_rule: Single top-left gloss ellipse at 30% white on buttons and tiles covering the top 35% of the element; no specular on text panels; eyes get one white dot
catalog_rules.shadow_rule: Offset shadow 0 4px 0 in the outline colour (hard) plus 0 6px 12px 15% black (soft); pressed state removes the hard offset and translates the element down 3px
catalog_rules.typography_direction: Rounded sans display (Fredoka / M PLUS Rounded 1c / Zen Maru Gothic for JP) 700 for titles; body Nunito or Noto Sans JP 500; title case; tabular numerals; letter-spacing +1% on display only
catalog_rules.icon_style: Filled rounded glyphs with 2px darker-shade outline matching the button rule; two-tone max; never thin-stroke icons
catalog_rules.illustration_style: Chibi animals with 2:1 head-to-body ratio, dot eyes with single white highlight, blush circles, smiles only; vector flat with one soft shade band in a hue-shifted (toward purple) darker tone
catalog_rules.button_rule: Pill primary 56px tall, fill = primary, 3px darker-shade outline, 4px hard bottom shadow, label 18px 700 centred with 1px darker text shadow; secondary = surface fill with primary outline; pressed = translate 3px down and drop shadow in 90ms
catalog_rules.panel_popup_rule: Rounded panel radius 28px, surface fill, 4px outline in secondary-darker, ribbon title plate overlapping the top edge by 50%; close button circular 44px top-right; entrance scale 0.85 to 1 with overshoot 1.04 in 260ms
catalog_rules.hud_rule: Top bar 64px with coin/life/timer capsules (pill, surface fill, 2px outline); timer bar uses accent fill with rounded ends; never more than 3 capsules; gameplay grid gets at least 85% of vertical space in portrait
catalog_rules.reward_rule: Reward popups go one saturation step higher (accent plus gold); confetti of 3 shapes max (circle, star, heart) in palette colours; mascot cheer pose; sparkle burst 6-8 rays; bounce to 1.1 scale synced to sound
catalog_rules.best_for: Tile-matching and onet puzzles, casual collection games, mascot-driven puzzle apps for all ages
catalog_rules.avoid_for: Competitive or hardcore genres, dark narrative games, enterprise apps, anything needing a serious tone
catalog_rules.reference_notes: Japanese casual puzzle and onet-style games with chibi animal mascots, soft coloured outlines, cream backgrounds and ribbon-titled popups; Japanese mascot (yuru-chara) design conventions

genre_profile.name: Onet Animal Puzzle
genre_profile.reward_loop: Level clear -> 1-3 stars by remaining time -> coins -> boosters; daily login chest; collection album unlocks animal species
genre_profile.touch_rules: Tiles min 44x44 logical even on 10x14 boards (scale the board to fit, never shrink tiles below 40); selection feedback within 1 frame; link path visible 120-200ms; booster buttons 64px with 8px gap; tap only, no gestures
genre_profile.performance_notes: Boards up to 140 tiles must redraw at 60fps; animal icons in one sprite atlas; path line as a single polyline; no per-tile shadows (bake into atlas)
